tasks.title: modules/credsource/passbolt: passbolt: resolver (OpenPGP robot, native-Go)

scenarios: The Passbolt resolver retrieves a resource field via an OpenPGP robot identity
A new backend registers read-only at the scheme registry and fails closed

tasks.notes: go-passbolt (pin+vendor), JWT preferred + GPGAuth fallback. SECOND-TIER; ref grammar passbolt:<resourceID>#<field>.
tasks.status_evidence: Completed 2026-08-23: modules/credsource/passbolt — the passbolt: scheme in native Go over the MAINTAINED OpenPGP fork (github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto, NOT the frozen x/crypto/openpgp that documents itself unsafe-by-design; this is a robot-identity security path). Two-stage GPGAuth proof-of-possession, session-cookie jar, then two GETs; both Passbolt secret shapes (bare password and the JSON object) handled, metadata fields from the resource record. Read-only and fail-closed on every direction incl. a public-key-only configuration and a key that will not unlock. Wired through wireCredentialDelivery (OFF unless TG_PASSBOLT_ADDR is set; env-parity-registered, compose-forwarded, .env.example documented), publishes a catalog Descriptor, and flips the tier selector row from NOT IMPLEMENTED to a live homelab-tier backend. Four oracle groups incl. a fake server that accepts stage 2 ONLY on the exact decrypted nonce, so a wrong key cannot log in.

tasks.notes: Password Manager API only (Secrets Manager is a NON-GOAL, unsupported by Vaultwarden). Native-Go Bitwarden E2E crypto (PBKDF2/Argon2id + AES-CBC-HMAC EtM). Highest crypto risk; SECOND-TIER; ref grammar vw:<collection>/<item>#<field>.
tasks.status_evidence: Completed 2026-08-23: modules/credsource/vaultwarden — the vw: scheme in native Go (no bw CLI, no subprocess, distroless-safe): PBKDF2-SHA256 derivation pinned to the PUBLISHED known-answer vector, the labelled HKDF stretch to a distinct (enc,mac) pair, and AES-256-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 cipher strings MAC-verified in constant time BEFORE decryption, with validated PKCS#7. Read-only, fail-closed on every direction (unreachable, wrong password, unknown item, absent field, tampered ciphertext/iv/mac, unsupported type). Wired through wireCredentialDelivery (OFF unless TG_VAULTWARDEN_ADDR is set; env-parity-registered, compose-forwarded, .env.example documented), egress-metered like the OpenBao client, and it publishes a catalog Descriptor so the console generates its dialog. Four oracle groups incl. an end-to-end fake vault that asserts the master password never reaches the server.

tasks.title: Shape-scan the real process environment so a raw credential nobody declared cannot boot green

scenarios: A raw credential in the process environment fails the boot under enforce

tasks.notes: TG-284. The enumerated gate (REQ-2402) could only see what a caller declared, so the live worker booted green under enforce while holding LIBRENMS_GR_TOKEN (64 chars) and LIBRENMS_TOKEN (32 chars) raw in its own process env. CheckEnvShape walks os.Environ() and reports a variable whose NAME declares a credential while its VALUE carries no reference scheme. False positives are handled structurally (a raw value reached by a permanently exempt reference inherits that exemption; a raw value reached by a declared reference is reported once, under the reference) plus a 5-entry allowlist of names that hold no credential at all.
